scripts.build: pnpm build:sidecar && pnpm build:web && pnpm build:desktop
scripts.test: pnpm test:go && pnpm test:web && pnpm test:rust
scripts.test:rust: cargo test --manifest-path apps/desktop/src-tauri/Cargo.toml && cargo test --locked --manifest-path apps/file-security-helper/Cargo.toml
scripts.check:tauri: cargo check --manifest-path apps/desktop/src-tauri/Cargo.toml && cargo check --locked --manifest-path apps/file-security-helper/Cargo.toml
scripts.check:web: pnpm typecheck && pnpm lint:web && pnpm test:web && pnpm build:web
scripts.check:go: pnpm check:temp && pnpm format:go:check && pnpm test:go && pnpm vet:go && pnpm build:sidecar
scripts.check:rust: pnpm check:temp && node --test scripts/build-desktop.test.mjs && pnpm check:tauri && pnpm test:rust
scripts.check:source: pnpm format:check && pnpm check:docs && pnpm check:scripts && pnpm check:web && pnpm check:go
scripts.format: prettier --write package.json pnpm-workspace.yaml README.md README.en.md docs scripts apps/web apps/desktop/package.json && pnpm format:go && pnpm format:rust
scripts.format:check: prettier --check package.json pnpm-workspace.yaml README.md README.en.md docs scripts apps/web apps/desktop/package.json && pnpm format:go:check && pnpm format:rust:check
scripts.format:rust: cargo fmt --manifest-path apps/desktop/src-tauri/Cargo.toml && cargo fmt --manifest-path apps/file-security-helper/Cargo.toml
scripts.format:rust:check: cargo fmt --manifest-path apps/desktop/src-tauri/Cargo.toml --check && cargo fmt --manifest-path apps/file-security-helper/Cargo.toml --check
